what: shift of each square of the crop between the two orthophotos (phase correlation)

fields.row, col: top-left pixel of the square in the crop
fields.peak: correlation peak, 0-1; below 0.15 is not used

summary.method: registration: phase correlation of the photos in squares of window_m (rock and texture should not move); sand_edges: phase correlation of dark-sand masks (stretched brightness < 50) in squares that are 15%-85% sand, squares overlapping by half; 'moving' = shift of at least 1.5 px

published_rates.what: dune migration, south-west part of the Bagnold field
published_rates.source: Silvestro, S., et al. (2013). Pervasive aeolian activity along rover Curiosity's traverse in Gale Crater, Mars. Geology, 41(4), 483-486. https://doi.org/10.1130/G34162.1

published_rates.what: upper bound for the Bagnold Dunes from orbital images
